beans.source: Yield: Talas average 2026 and 2024 (topnews.kg). Price: autumn 2026 market low (naq.media, 12 Oct 2026) to planned state purchase (economist.kg, 23 Dec 2025)

potato.source: Yield: national average 17.65 t/ha in 2025 (Kabar, 17 Nov 2025) to 30 t/ha for early potato in Manas district, Talas (economist.kg, 6 Jul 2026). Price: farm-gate 15-17 som/kg after the 2026 harvest (economist.kg, 8 Oct 2026)

sugarbeet.source: Yield: 2026 plan of 650,000 t on 11,800 ha (Rossiyskaya Gazeta, 11 Nov 2026). Price: factory purchase 5,400-5,500 som/t, paid 30% in cash and 70% in sugar (economist.kg, 10 Oct 2026; Turmush)

wheat.source: Yield: grain average 29.6 c/ha in 2025 (Kabar, 17 Nov 2025) to 30-40 c/ha in Manas district, Talas (economist.kg, 6 Jul 2026). Price: average retail price of feed wheat, early October 2026 (State Antimonopoly monitoring via economist.kg, 7 Oct 2026); farmers selling in bulk get less, so this is an upper bound

maize.source: Yield: grain maize national average 69.5 c/ha, 2024 harvest (Ministry of Agriculture via economist.kg, 29 Oct 2024). Price: average retail price of maize, early October 2026 (State Antimonopoly monitoring via economist.kg, 7 Oct 2026); farmers selling in bulk get less, so this is an upper bound

barley.source: Yield: national average 18.3 c/ha in 2025 (economist.kg, 26 Jan 2026) to 25.9 c/ha in 2024 (Ministry of Agriculture via economist.kg, 29 Oct 2024). Price: average producer price 20,849 som/t in July 2026 to 24,971 som/t in March 2026 (National Statistical Committee via zerno.ru)

safflower.source: Yield: national average 10.1 c/ha in 2025 (Ministry of Agriculture via economist.kg, 28 Apr 2026) to 10.9 c/ha in 2024 (24.kg, 14 Jul 2025). Price: seed bought by a Chuy safflower-oil maker at 32-34 som/kg (economist.kg interview, 6 Feb 2025); 2026 sale ads ask 35-40 som/kg for cleaned seed
